log: Working out who would actually buy this
Rechecking product fit for the same audiences; market evidence is retained

Discovery only, not validation. Public discussions are self-selected and some recent Reddit replies contain promotion or unverifiable personal claims. Corporate examples are supplier-authored case studies. Searches found strong counterevidence for wedding planners, photo-book editor reliability, baby-book completion and garden-journal maintenance. Coverage remains thin for letter-writing paper, games, wine journals, recipe journals, wholesale retailers, delivery reliability by product and non-English buyer communities. No population sizes or response-rate estimates were inferred.
